date.as_written: samvat 859 mārgāśira śukre || ekādaśī, kunhu ... pūni (!), kuhnu

notes: The Newari colophon notes the copying was started at Vucākvāṭha on the 11th tithi and completed ('corā' / 'colā') at Bharākvāṭha on the full moon day ('pūni kuhnu'). The cataloguer gave NS 858, but the colophon text reads 859.
